recognize_zh: 高倍下是一片單調的小至中型淋巴細胞，核形略不規則、有輕度凹陷，染色質中度濃縮、核仁不明顯，細胞質稀少，其間可見小的粉紅色透明化血管，沒有混雜的大細胞，符合套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Monotonous population of small to medium lymphoid cells
Slightly irregular to indented nuclear contours
Moderately dense chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant pale cytoplasm; no admixed large transformed cells
Small hyalinized eosinophilic capillary in the field
describe_en: High-power section shows sheets of monotonous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with slightly irregular, focally indented nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. A small hyalinized vessel is present, and there is no admixture of centroblasts, immunoblasts or plasma cells. Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma; cyclin D1 and SOX11 immunohistochemistry is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL cells have round nuclei with clumped chromatin and proliferation centers, and are CD23/LEF1 positive and cyclin D1 negative.
FL shows angulated cleaved centrocytes with centroblasts in a follicular pattern and is CD10/BCL6 positive and CD5/cyclin D1 negative.
LPL contains plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with Dutcher bodies and MYD88 L265P, lacking cyclin D1.
